Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
Chris Arthur wrote:
> 1. If you ghoul an ally is his starting amount considered one greater
> than his card text? i.e. If Muddles was Ghouled and down to one life
> could the Vagabond Mystic tap to give him another?

No. The mortal is recruited as normal and is still a mortal when recruited.
Then, once the recruitment is successful, the Ghouled card is placed on
the ally (converting him to a Ghoul) and the ally gains 1 life.

Aside: Therefore, Sunset Strip could be used to reduce the cost of the
soon-to-be ghoul, since he's not yet a non-mortal.

> 2. Is Jake Washington's starting amount considered 1? If not, can the
> Mystics add as much life to him as they want?

His starting life is 1, yes.

The only other alternative would be that he has no effective starting
life, so VM would not be usable at all (cf. Grandest Trick), so this
ruling doesn't affect the utility of the Mystic one way or the other
with respect to Jake.
